candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory reservation failures (503) that propagate through order to gateway checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs not admitted; root cause of the Redis timeout (saturation, network, config) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, cascading to inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway checkout 502s; metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2.4s) and 502s. Topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis path. Redis-side evidence is excluded, so the underlying Redis fault is not fully bounded.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency/error metrics and logs to confirm the timeout origin
Inventory service logs correlating reserve_inventory failures
